moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival wraps up
moments.blurb: The twin Reading and Leeds Festivals are happening this Bank Holiday weekend, featuring headliners like Charli XCX, Fontaines D.C., Chase & Status, and Florence + The Machine.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festival is closing out the summer with a bang! Who's caught Charli XCX, Fontaines D.C. or Florence + The Machine this weekend? Tell us your highlight!

angles.name: Line-up Buzz
angles.copy: From Chase & Status to Loyle Carner, the Reading & Leeds line-up is huge this Bank Holiday. What's been the best set you've seen or heard about?

moments.title: US Open Tennis main draw begins
moments.blurb: The US Open tennis championships continue in New York, with the main draw singles play set to begin on Sunday, August 30th.

angles.name: Grand Slam Kick-off
angles.copy: The final Grand Slam of the year is well underway! The US Open main draw kicks off properly this Sunday. Who are you backing for the title?

angles.name: Tennis Fever
angles.copy: Hard court action from New York! The US Open is bringing all the drama. Any early upsets or standout performances caught your eye?

moments.title: Premier League action continues
moments.blurb: The Premier League season is in full swing with matches scheduled across the Bank Holiday weekend and into early September, including Crystal Palace v Man City (Aug 28), Aston Villa v Arsenal (Aug 31), and Arsenal v Chelsea (Sep 6).

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures
angles.copy: It's a huge weekend of Premier League football! Who's playing who, and what are your score predictions for the big games?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Football
angles.copy: Bank Holiday Monday means more Premier League! Aston Villa host Arsenal, while Man Utd take on Ipswich. Grab a cuppa and settle in!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday weekend
moments.blurb: The late August Bank Holiday is observed across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland on Monday, August 31st, marking a final long weekend of summer.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: It's the last Bank Holiday of summer on Monday! How are you making the most of the long weekend? Away somewhere or chilling at home?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: Don't let the Bank Holiday blues hit! It's our last chance for a three-day weekend until Christmas. What's on your agenda?

moments.title: UK Singles Chart latest
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the UK Singles Chart #1 spot for a phenomenal 22nd week (chart for Aug 21-27), with the next chart due for release.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are dominating the UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In' for 22 weeks. Is it one of your favourite tracks right now?

angles.name: New Chart Watch
angles.copy: The new UK Singles Chart is incoming! Will 'Rein Me In' make it 23 weeks at the top, or is there a new contender ready to snatch the crown?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing returns
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated new series of Strictly Come Dancing is set to launch with its pre-recorded show on Saturday, September 19th, followed by the first live performances on Saturday, September 26th.

angles.name: Strictly Countdown
angles.copy: Get ready to dust off your dancing shoes! Strictly Come Dancing is back on September 19th. Who are you most excited to see hit the ballroom?

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: A new era for Strictly with Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe hosting! Are you ready for the glitterball glamour to return?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off season 16 launch
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is set to return for its 16th season on Channel 4 on Tuesday, September 24th, bringing a fresh batch of bakers to the tent.

angles.name: Bake Off Buzz
angles.copy: The tent is back! The Great British Bake Off returns on September 24th. What bakes are you hoping to see, and who do you think will get the first handshake?

angles.name: New Judge Nigella
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a judge for the new series of Bake Off! Exciting times for fans of soggy bottoms and perfect pastries. Tune in from September 24th.

moments.title: Happy 45th Birthday, Beyoncé
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé, born on September 4, 1981, celebrates her 45th birthday next week.

angles.name: Queen Bey Turns 45
angles.copy: All hail Queen Bey! Beyoncé turns 45 next week on September 4th. What's your all-time favourite Beyoncé track or Destiny's Child classic?

angles.name: Celebrating Beyoncé
angles.copy: From 'Crazy in Love' to 'Break My Soul', Beyoncé has given us so many anthems. Join us in celebrating her 45th birthday next week by requesting your favourite!
